snippet.title: "Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?: Battle Chronicle"  Introduction
snippet.description:
Release on August 24rd & Pre-registrations is Now Open!
Goddess Hestia introduces the game like a VTuber!
Pre-registration: https://app.adjust.com/10zj9aiu

▼Official Website
https://www.danmachi-danchro.com/en/

▼Twitter
https://www.danmachi-danchro.com/en/

▼Discord
https://discord.gg/danmachi-danchro

▼""Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?: Battle Chronicle""
A game that allows you to relive the story and famous battles of """"Danmachi"""" with characters featured in anime-style 3D graphics!

In the simple yet profound """"Battle"""" mode, players can enjoy exhilarating action with a variety of attacks and evasions, including the special moves from the story!
Create your own party by combining multiple training elements such as ""Adventurers,"" ""Assists,"" and ""Scene Cards,"" and set out on your own adventures.

The game is also packed with other content, including a battle royale in which everyone is your enemy except you, and autoplay battles in which organization is key.
Challenge the dungeons with familiar characters like Bell and Ais!

▼Voice actors
Bell Cranel (VA: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka),
Hestia (VA: Inori Minase),
Welf Crozzo (VA: Yoshimasa Hosoya)
Liliruca Arde (VA: Maaya Uchida),
Yamato Mikoto (VA: Chinatsu Akasaki) 
Sanjouno Haruhime (VA: Haruka Chisuga)
Ryu Lion (VA: Saori Hayami)
Ais Wallenstein (VA: Saori Onishi)
and more.

▼""Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?: Battle Chronicle""
A popular series that has sold over 12 million copies with 4 seasons of an anime series, as well as OVA episodes.
As of 2023, a project is underway to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the original work, and ""DanChro"" will be announced as one of the projects.

▼Story Summary

Labyrinth City Orario
The home to the monstrous underground labyrinth known as Dungeon. A boy named Bell arrives seeking the excitement of the unknown, honor, and above all, romance with a cute girl.
The story begins when he meets the little goddess Hestia. A fateful encounter between an aspiring adventurer who was rejected by all the Familia and a god with a guild with no members.
This is the story of a boy as told by a goddess– a “Familia Myth"".

▼""Danmachi"" Official Website :
https://danmachi.com/

#Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?: Battle Chronicle
#danmachi #Danchro
